usedFor: Shopify holds the store, and Cliengo receives the shopper through “Create Customer” after an “Abandoned Checkout”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Customer” in Cliengo
bestTemplate.why: A checkout carries the shopper's email or phone, so Cliengo gets a customer record to follow up on.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so “Create Customer” runs after a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
